subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should OpenClaw approve a browser-direct `describe_view` Video Talk feature that enables camera access for Control UI and sends captured frames directly to OpenAI Realtime and Gemini Live providers?
rationale: The patch changes a camera permission boundary and provider image-data path, and automation cannot decide the intended consent scope or provider coverage for this feature.

options.title: Scope And Prove Camera Access
options.body: Keep `camera=()` as the shared default, add a Control UI-only camera permission path, align camera-denial behavior, rebase cleanly, and require real browser/provider proof before merge.

options.title: Approve Broad Same-Origin Camera Access
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept `camera=(self)` globally only if security review confirms every same-origin Gateway response should be camera-capable.

options.title: Pause For Transport Design
options.body: Pause this browser-direct PR if maintainers want the broader provider/gateway frame transport in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131 settled first.

recommendation.title: Scope And Prove Camera Access
recommendation.body: Keep `camera=()` as the shared default, add a Control UI-only camera permission path, align camera-denial behavior, rebase cleanly, and require real browser/provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and have the strongest adjacent history on browser realtime Talk and Control UI session controls.
